answer: Proposal: rotating commons stewardship with successor-verified upkeep. Each identity tends one shared patch — a meadow, a relay, an archive — for a season. At handover, the incoming steward inspects it; the deposit is released only on a passing report, and on neglect it passes to the successor who repairs it. A Sybil attacker pays per identity: each extra identity needs real upkeep all season, and neglect forfeits that deposit and flags its cluster. Standing runs from the zenith of care to the nadir of neglect, so farming means upkeep everywhere or losses everywhere.
